fields.Name: ORD-37 - Term Extension
fields.Description: A booked term extended at no charge, with recognition, access and renewal following (TX1-TX9). The approved Duration concession is the amendment: approving it moves the term's end and the selling line's service period, mirrors every staged recognition entry dated on or after the effective date on its own date, and spreads what they were going to recognise from the first of them to the new end, with no catch-up and no receivable entry. Access that follows the term runs to the new end, an Extended subscription event names the concession and pairs each offset with what it offsets, and accounting is assigned a task to confirm the re-cut. An extension is refused when no acknowledgment role is configured, when only the requester holds it, and when the term's renewal is already placed. Orders.AmendArrangement previews without writing, then records and applies.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: A 90-day extension inside authority is Approved on save; the term and line end 90 days later; the recognition entries linked to the term still sum to the term's amount, include offsets, and recognise nothing after the new end; no non-recognition entry is written; an Extended event names the concession and the new end; an Open ACTION_ITEM task links the term and the order and is assigned to the acknowledgment role's holder but not the requester. A Pending extension changes nothing until approved, then applies; a rejected one changes nothing. No acknowledgment role, or a role only the requester holds, refuses the extension; so does a placed renewal. After an extension the renewal is placed against the new end and dated the day after it. A preview writes nothing, not even the concession; the same call without Preview applies it; a change of amount is refused. Moving a booked term's end directly is still refused.
